properties.name: Finding
properties.purpose:
The detectors — the parts whose job is to NOTICE something the design cannot see in itself: gaps, structural defects, hierarchy problems, undeclared seams, granularity mismatches, coverage and consumption holes.

Separated from Telling deliberately, and that separation is the point rather than tidiness. `dec:reflow2-is-built-for-observability` says this design is built so its answers never misrepresent what it knows, and observability-driven allocation wants THE INSTRUMENT SEPARATED FROM THE SUBJECT — a part that finds a problem must not be the same part that decides how loudly to report it. Fusing detection and reporting is how a green gate over uncovered ground gets built without anybody choosing to.

Every part here owes the same obligation the target imposes: it must be able to say it COULD NOT TELL, rather than reporting clean over ground it never ran on.
